Subject: Subprocessor inventory & SOC2 — Biomedix onboarding

Hi Aisha,

We're kicking off security intake for the Biomedix production integration and need a few items to close procurement and the security review by next Friday (2026-07-09):

- Full subprocessor inventory (vendor name, service provided, country, data access type)
- Copy of SOC 2 Type II (most recent) or SOC bridge letter if SOC is older than 12 months
- SIG/CAIQ answers or a SIG-lite evidence bundle (if you have a consolidated export, that helps)
- High-level dataflow diagram showing how Biomedix data will traverse Redwood (ingress, storage, third-party exchanges)

Two clarifying points: are any Redwood subprocessors expected to have access to PHI for our configuration or integrations? Also, please confirm encryption-at-rest and key management approach for customer data.

If possible, attach the artifacts to this thread or share a time-limited link. We're triaging this on the Contract & Security side and can fast-track once docs are in.

Thanks — appreciate a rough ETA.

Jordan Mills
Security Program Manager
Biomedix Health
security@biomedix.com

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick answers up front:

- PHI: Redwood does not process PHI by default for the hosted API; however depending on customer configuration (e.g., if you push PHI into prompts or embeddings) that would be customer-controlled. Please confirm whether you plan to send PHI so we can document any required contractual protections.
- Encryption: All customer data at rest is encrypted with customer-segregated keys where requested; by default we use cloud KMS with customer-managed keys available on Dedicated/Private plans.

Action plan:
1) I'll compile the subprocessor CSV and a redacted dataflow diagram and attach them to this thread by EOD.
2) Vivek will assemble the SOC 2 and SIG-lite evidence packet for sharing via time-limited GDrive link.
3) Marcus, please flag any legal/contractual concerns for PHI-related handling; do we need a Data Processing Addendum or any extra language for Biomedix?

ETA: initial packet (subprocessor list + diagram) by today 5pm PT; SOC/SIG bundle tomorrow morning. If that timeline doesn't work for procurement, tell us and we'll accelerate.

Best,
